content.rationale: The proposed change removes the .sort() call from uniqueStable, which was causing the test failure by reordering the deduplicated values. The new implementation [...new Set(values)] correctly preserves the first-occurrence order of the input values, which matches the expected behavior described in the test 'deduplication preserves first occurrence order'. The test output confirms that all 3 tests pass with this change, including the previously failing one. There are no security or correctness defects in this minimal change.
